vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: karpathy-wiki-cn
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle is designed to implement a research knowledge management system (Karpathy LLM Wiki). The included scripts (scripts/search-agent-papers.sh and .py) are used to query the official arXiv API and download research papers in PDF format to a local directory. The instructions in SKILL.md are strictly focused on maintaining the wiki structure and do not contain any malicious prompt injections or requests for sensitive data. The behavior is entirely consistent with the stated purpose of research paper management.

llm.summary: The skill's code and instructions match its stated purpose (building and maintaining a local Karpathy-style LLM wiki): it downloads recent arXiv papers and reads/writes the described wiki files, and it does not request secrets or contact unexpected endpoints.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (Karpathy LLM Wiki) align with the provided SKILL.md and the two bundled scripts: both scripts query arXiv and download PDFs into raw/papers, and the SKILL.md describes ingest/query/lint workflows that operate on local raw/ and wiki/ directories. The requested capabilities (file I/O, arXiv network access) are proportionate to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to read and write many repository files (raw/, wiki/, wiki/log.md, index.md, etc.) and to '自动修复' issues during linting — i.e., the LLM is expected to autonomously modify wiki content. That is coherent for this kind of tool but is an important behavioral surface: the skill will make persistent edits to local files and append log entries.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is provided (instruction-only with bundled scripts). This is the lowest-risk installation model; nothing is downloaded/installed by the skill itself beyond running the included scripts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, no credentials, and no config paths. The included scripts perform only network calls to arXiv/export.arxiv.org and arxiv.org (expected for paper downloads). No secrets or unrelated service credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false (not force-included). disable-model-invocation is default false (agent may invoke autonomously), which is normal; this combined with the skill's ability to edit local files is expected but worth noting for the user. The skill does not attempt to modify other skills or system-wide settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is internally consistent and appears to do what it claims: it will download papers from arXiv and read/write files under the repo (raw/, wiki/, wiki/log.md) and may autonomously edit wiki pages during 'lint' and 'ingest' workflows. Before installing/running: (1) back up any existing wiki/raw directories you care about, (2) inspect or create the referenced CLAUDE.md schema (SKILL.md references it but it's not included), and (3) be aware that the bundled scripts will write PDFs to raw/papers. Note: the shell script file includes duplicated Python content after an exec (likely an accidental concatenation) — harmless but messy; you may want to run the Python script directly or clean the shell wrapper.
